title: Saint Martin's Island access is rationed
text: In the 2025-26 season visitors were allowed 1 Nov to 31 Jan, up to 2,000 a day, day trips only in November and overnight stays only in Dec and Jan, with an online travel pass. Check the 2026-27 rules before booking.

title: Hill tourism can close at short notice
text: Access has been restricted during heavy rain, landslides and security situations. Confirm with the district administration or your operator before you travel.

title: Sundarbans trips: book official packages
text: The Forest Department sells permit-inclusive packages. Reported prices run about Tk 8,000-12,000 (non-AC) and Tk 14,000-25,000 (AC) per person for 3 days. The park is closed for the monsoon and reopens on 1 September.

title: Bus fares have risen
text: Intercity non-AC bus fares were raised by 17 paisa per km in September 2026, to about Tk 2.40 per km. AC coach fares are not set by the BRTA chart and are usually higher.

title: Emergency numbers
text: Call 999 for police, fire or ambulance (press 2 for English). Bangladesh Tourist Police helpline: 01320-222222 or 01887-878787.
